body:
## Summary

Read the whole path end-to-end (`pipeline::check` → `layout` → `paint` → `emit`) plus the CLI batch/emit glue. No `Scene`/`Chart`/`Placed`/`Document` is ever **structurally** cloned — the cloning cost is entirely in per-element `String`s duplicated between stages, in per-number `format!` temporaries, and in re-shaping text with harfrust on every measurement call (no cache). Raster re-parses the SVG and re-registers both fonts on every `encode` call. No forbidden ADR construct exists in these files (no `unwrap`/`panic`/`HashMap`/`rand`/clock/`unsafe`/`f32::to_string`; production `as` casts are only at `flow.rs:79-86` and `raster.rs:119-127`, both behind `#[expect(..., reason = ...)]`; every target file is < 300 lines).

---

## 1. Unnecessary clones

- `crates/akribie-cli/src/commands/render/batch.rs:149` — `(None, None, Some(source)) => source.clone()` — copies the **entire source text** per batch item that inlines `source`; O(document bytes) per item.
- `crates/akribie-core/src/layout/finish.rs:30,78,80,209-213` — `Placed` rebuilds every `node.id`, `group.id`, `group.label`, `edge.from`, `edge.to`, `edge.label` as fresh `String`s — one ID copy per node, three per edge, plus the whole label text; a full second copy of all identifiers.
- `crates/akribie-core/src/paint/mod.rs:243` and `crates/akribie-core/src/paint/group.rs:49` — `text: line.clone()` per wrapped line — `Scene` duplicates every label line produced by `Placed`.
- `crates/akribie-core/src/paint/node.rs:14` (`Some(shape.clone())`) with `:49`/`:63` (`shape.to_string()`) — the node's `d` path string is duplicated 2–3× (clip + fill + stroke); paths are the largest strings in the document.
- `crates/akribie-core/src/paint/edge.rs:40,52` — `text.clone()` + `aria_label: edge.label.clone()` — the edge label lives three times (`PlacedEdge.label`, `TextRun.text`, `aria_label`).
- `crates/akribie-core/src/paint/group.rs:20,28,63` — `group.label.clone()`, `group.id.clone()`, `shape.clone()` per group.
- `crates/akribie-core/src/paint/mod.rs:181-182` — `title.clone()`, `lang.clone()` — small, one-shot.
- `crates/akribie-core/src/layout/tree.rs:73`, `crates/akribie-core/src/layout/radial.rs:52,72` — `children.get(index).cloned().unwrap_or_default()` inside the recursion — clones a `Vec<usize>` at every visited node; O(N+E) allocations per layout.
- `crates/akribie-core/src/layout/tree.rs:43` — `for root in roots.clone()` — avoids a borrow, copies the root list once (negligible).
- `crates/akribie-cli/src/commands/render/batch.rs:117,124,163` — `item.error.clone()`, `params.path.clone()`, `params.out.clone()` — per item, small.
- **CLEAN**: no `.clone()` on `Scene`, `Chart`, `Placed`, `Document`/`CheckReport` anywhere in `akribie-core` or `akribie-cli` (verified by pattern search).
- Note (retention, not copy): `crates/akribie-cli/src/commands/render.rs:106-127` keeps the whole parsed `Document` alive inside `report` for the entire render although only `chart` is used.

## 2. String building in emit

**SVG — assembled via many small `String`s, not one accumulator.**
- `crates/akribie-core/src/emit/svg.rs:16,77` — top-level `Vec<String> parts` + `parts.join("\n")`: the final join copies the whole document a second time.
- `crates/akribie-core/src/emit/svg.rs:91,120,129,143` — each element gets its *own* `Vec<String>`; `crates/akribie-core/src/emit/svg.rs:174` (`parts.join("")`) copies each element body again → element text is materialized ~2× plus the document copy at `:77` (≈3× total bytes).
- Per-element temporary count: node with solid fill + stroke + 1 label line = 10–12 heap `String`s (`:94` fill, `:178-189` stroke + optional dash, `:192-206` text run = 3×`num` + `escape` + `format!`, `:167-175` wrap = aria + `escape(id)` + `join` + `format!`), plus `Vec<String>`. A labelled edge is 17–19 (`:146` two arrow paths, `:154` rect with 4 `num`, `:192-206`, `:167-175`).
- `crates/akribie-core/src/emit/svg.rs:38-40,100` — `escape(&id_of(&node.id))`: `id_of` (`:209-219`) allocates a `String`, `escape` (`:222-233`) allocates another, per clip path/hachure reference. `escape` copies unconditionally even with nothing to escape.
- `crates/akribie-core/src/emit/svg.rs:76,87` — `"</svg>".to_string()`, `"</g>".to_string()`: constant strings heap-allocated then copied by `join`.
- `crates/akribie-core/src/emit/svg.rs:80-82` — `section` collects the iterator into a fresh `Vec<String>` before checking emptiness, so 4 extra `Vec`s per document even when sections are empty.

**`scene` JSON — one `Value` tree materialized in full, then serialized.**
- `crates/akribie-core/src/emit/scene_json.rs:20-33` + `:44` `to_string_pretty` — the document exists twice in memory (tree + text).
- `crates/akribie-core/src/emit/scene_json.rs:49-61` — `node_value` allocates ~17–19 heap objects (7 string `Value`s + 5 `num::json` + `Map`), `label` adds `join(" ")`.
- `crates/akribie-core/src/num.rs:18-21` — `json()` = `format(...)` `String` → `parse::<serde_json::Number>()` → `Value`: 2 allocations + a float parse per emitted number; every node emits 5, every rect 4, every route point 2 (`scene_json.rs:101`).
- `crates/akribie-core/src/emit/scene_json.rs:67` — `format!("{}->{}#{}")` per edge (recomputed, same string also built at `paint/edge.rs:51`).

**`.excalidraw` — `Value` tree, one `String` per JSON key.**
- `crates/akribie-core/src/emit/excalidraw.rs:24,44-46` — `Vec<Value>` + single `to_string_pretty` (output built once, but the tree is the dominant cost).
- `crates/akribie-core/src/emit/excalidraw/support.rs:44-76` (`base`, ~22 keys), `:84-133` (`text_element`, ~20 keys), `:19` (`map.insert(key.to_string(), …)`) — **every JSON key is heap-allocated per element**, i.e. ~22 + ~20 + 4–6 `set()` keys ≈ **≈50 key/key-value `String`s per node pair**; `shapes.rs:39` allocates a throwaway `{"id","type"}` object per `boundElements`.
- `crates/akribie-core/src/emit/excalidraw/edges.rs:30-31` — per route point `json!([...])` = 1 array `Value` + 2 `num::json` (2 allocs each) → ~5 allocations/point; `edges.rs:42,61` — `route_extent` called **twice** per edge, re-scanning the whole route.
- `crates/akribie-core/src/emit/excalidraw/support.rs:35,39` — `format!("a{}V", String::from_utf8_lossy(&digits))` + `format!("akr-{id}")` per element, then `excalidraw.rs:39` `set(...,"index",…)` allocates the key again.
- `crates/akribie-core/src/emit/excalidraw/edges.rs:32` — `element_id(&format!("{}->{}#{}", …))` — two `format!`s chained.

## 3. Raster path

- `crates/akribie-core/src/emit/raster.rs:56-60` — **every** `encode` builds a new `usvg::Options`, re-registers both faces via `load_font_data(FONT_BYTES.to_vec())` / `SANS_BYTES.to_vec()` (heap copy of *both* full TTFs), and re-parses the SVG with `usvg::Tree::from_str`. No cache of `Options`/fontdb/tree: cost is paid per raster output, and per batch item.
- `crates/akribie-core/src/emit/raster.rs:68-72` — single-threaded `resvg::render` into `tiny_skia::Pixmap`; AVIF pinned to one thread at `:88-90` (`with_num_threads(Some(1))`) — **CLEAN/expected** per ADR §1/§2.
- `crates/akribie-cli/src/commands/render.rs:143-147` — for raster the SVG `String` is built only to be thrown away after `encode`: full document materialized, then re-parsed (one extra full-size buffer + full XML parse).
- `crates/akribie-core/src/emit/raster.rs:78,86` — `let mut buffer = Vec::new();` for JPEG/AVIF output (no capacity hint → realloc growth); `:96-105` `rgb()` copies 3/4 of the pixmap into a second buffer before encoding (PNG path avoids this).
- Font lifetime for measurement: `Font::load()` once per command (`commands/render.rs:105`, `commands/render/batch.rs:102`), never per draw — **CLEAN** for layout/paint. The raster fontdb, by contrast, is per `encode` call.
- `[INFERENCE]` `usvg::Options::default()` starts from an empty `fontdb`, so only the two embedded faces are registered (no system fonts) — consistent with the ADR.

## 4. Batch render

- `crates/akribie-cli/src/commands/render/batch.rs:171` — `pipeline::check` per item re-runs parse+resolve **plus diagnostics-only work render never consumes**: `missing_glyphs` (`pipeline.rs:32` → `:67-95`, per-character `charmap` lookup over every label), `a11y::check_contrast` (`pipeline.rs:33`), `isolated` (`pipeline.rs:31` → `model/mod.rs:163-167`, O(E) scan per node).
- `crates/akribie-cli/src/commands/render/batch.rs:169` — `Config::discover` per item (`config.rs:156-172`: `fs.exists` per parent directory up to the root) → repeated filesystem probing per line.
- `crates/akribie-cli/src/commands/render/batch.rs:186-193` — layout is recomputed per item; `paint` is recomputed identically for `Svg` and `Raster` (`render.rs:143-146`). Nothing is memoized across items: two lines with the same `path` and different `format` re-parse, re-resolve, re-layout, re-paint (and for raster also re-register fonts) the same input.
- Within one item there is exactly one output format, so there is **no** per-format duplication inside a single line — duplication is only across lines that name the same input. **CLEAN** in that narrow sense.
- `crates/akribie-cli/src/commands/render/batch.rs:102` — `Font::load()` hoisted out of the loop: **CLEAN** (one load per batch).

## 5. Text measurement

- `crates/akribie-core/src/text.rs:61-82` — `advance_px` constructs `ShaperFont::new(&self.face)` (`:65`) and `Buffer::new()` (`:66`) and shapes the **whole string** on every call. **No cache, no memo** — every measurement is a full harfrust shape.
- `crates/akribie-core/src/text.rs:105-131` — `place_word` builds a new `candidate` `String` per word (`:114-117`) and re-shapes the entire line-so-far (`:119`) → **O(words²)** shaped characters per paragraph; `:133-144` `break_word` does `format!("{chunk}{grapheme}")` + `advance_px` per grapheme → **O(graphemes²)**.
- `crates/akribie-core/src/text.rs:161-168` — `label_size` wraps, then re-shapes every resulting line (`:164-166`) — one extra full pass.
- `crates/akribie-core/src/layout/mod.rs:164-176` + `layout/finish.rs:33` → `layout/mod.rs:179-190` — every node label is measured via `label_size` and then wrapped **again** by `label_lines`: **2× shaping per node per layout**, regardless of `size` being declared.
- `crates/akribie-core/src/layout/finish.rs:145,148` — notes call `font.wrap(...)` and then `font.label_size(...)`, which wraps a third time.
- `crates/akribie-core/src/paint/edge.rs:37` — one `advance_px` per edge label (bounded, expected).
- `crates/akribie-core/src/text.rs:194-198` — `Font::load` is the only thing amortized; the `Gauge` is cached per command but no shaping result is.

## 6. O(n²) loops

- `crates/akribie-core/src/paint/edge.rs:81-87` — `label_rect` loops `while shift < 128.0`: from `shift ≈ h/2 + 6 ≈ 20` that is **≤ ~108 iterations**, each calling `clearance` (`:102-114`) = `(route.len()-1) × 17` distance evaluations → ~1.8k–3.7k `hypot` per labelled edge; cost scales with route length × iteration count.
- `crates/akribie-core/src/layout/finish.rs:64-88` with `:90-135` — `resolve_group` scans **all nodes** (`:109-116`) and **all groups** (`:117-124`) for each group → O(G·(N+G)), depth-bounded recursion with `visiting`+memo so O(G·N + G²) overall.
- `crates/akribie-core/src/layout/tree.rs:155-172` — `children[from].contains(&to)` per edge → O(E × max out-degree); same pattern at `crates/akribie-core/src/layout/radial.rs:109-111`.
- `crates/akribie-core/src/pipeline.rs:47-49` → `crates/akribie-core/src/model/mod.rs:163-167` — `chart.degree(&id)` per node scans all edges → **O(N·E) on every render** (via `check`), purely for W002.
- `crates/akribie-core/src/a11y.rs:16-42` → `model/mod.rs:171-173` (`label_of` → `node(id)` linear) — O(E·N); invoked on every render by `paint/mod.rs:184` and `emit/scene_json.rs:22`.
- `crates/akribie-core/src/emit/excalidraw/support.rs::binding` → `layout/mod.rs:134-136` (`Placed::node`, linear) — twice per edge (`edges.rs:42,50`) → O(E·N).
- `crates/akribie-core/src/emit/excalidraw/edges.rs:42,61` — `route_extent` twice per edge → 2× O(route).
- Bounds note: `PIXELS` cap 16384 (`raster.rs:111`) bounds raster memory; nothing bounds N/E except the parser.

## 7. Allocation hygiene

- `Vec::new()` in hot loops where the size is known: `crates/akribie-core/src/emit/svg.rs:16,91,120,143` (per element/section), `crates/akribie-core/src/sketch/hatch.rs:12,40` (`segments` = `(w+h)/step` and `h/step` entries), `crates/akribie-core/src/emit/excalidraw.rs:24` (`elements` ≈ 2× nodes + 2× notes + 2× labelled edges), `crates/akribie-core/src/pipeline.rs:179` (`lines`, count known from `input.lines()`), `crates/akribie-core/src/text.rs:90`.
- Correct `with_capacity`: `crates/akribie-core/src/emit/raster.rs:97`, `crates/akribie-core/src/sketch/shapes.rs:69`, `crates/akribie-core/src/emit/svg.rs:223`.
- `String::new()` grown by `push_str` in loops: `crates/akribie-core/src/sketch/shapes.rs:48` (`polyline`, rebuilt **twice** by `two_passes`), `:105` (`exact_rect`), `crates/akribie-core/src/text.rs:98` (`wrap_paragraph`), `:134` (`break_word`).
- Per-point temporaries: `crates/akribie-core/src/sketch/helpers.rs:7-17` — `moveto`/`lineto`/`xy` each `format!` a new `String`; called per point inside `polyline` (`shapes.rs:50-58`), so ≈2 `String`s per point per pass, and `sketch/rng.rs:76-82` runs the closure **twice** and concatenates with `format!` → 2× point work + a full copy for every rough shape.
- `to_string()` on hot paths: `crates/akribie-core/src/paint/node.rs:49,63` (`shape.to_string()`), `crates/akribie-core/src/paint/mod.rs:267` (`trimmed.to_string()` after `join`), `crates/akribie-core/src/emit/svg.rs:76,87` (constants), `crates/akribie-core/src/num.rs:11,22` (degenerate cases only).
- `crates/akribie-core/src/num.rs:8-24` — `format()` allocates one `String` per number and is called for every path coordinate, every SVG attribute and (twice over) for every `scene` number via `json()`.
- `crates/akribie-cli/src/commands/render/batch.rs:55,60` — `failure()` clones the message `String` on every call; invoked once per item per emit pass (`app/emit/batch.rs:79,142`) and once more in `ok()`/JSON branches.
- `crates/akribie-cli/src/app/emit/batch.rs:65,128` — `String::new()` for the whole batch text with no capacity estimate (number of lines is known).

---

### Critical Files for Implementation
- `crates/akribie-core/src/text.rs` — `advance_px`/`wrap`/`place_word`/`label_size` are the uncached harfrust hot path (items 5, 7).
- `crates/akribie-core/src/emit/svg.rs` — per-element `Vec<String>` + double `join`, `num`/`escape` temporaries (item 2).
- `crates/akribie-core/src/emit/raster.rs` — per-call `usvg::Options`, TTF `to_vec()` copies, SVG re-parse, single-thread encode (item 3).
- `crates/akribie-cli/src/commands/render/batch.rs` — per-item `Config::discover`, `pipeline::check`, re-layout, `source.clone()` (items 1, 4).
- `crates/akribie-core/src/layout/finish.rs` — `resolve_group` O(G·(N+G)) plus the second label wrap and full ID/label copying (items 1, 6).
